full_name: Soledad Loaeza | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2003–2004 Social Sciences Ford Fellow El Colegio de Mexico
bio: Soledad Loaeza’s most recent book, El Partido Acción Nacional, la larga marcha, 1939–1994, (Fondo de Cultura Economica, 1999), is the product of her long-term interest in twentieth-century Mexican conservatism.
